sys_atf_test.description: Validates SnackFlow Stock Balance Post (after/200) and SnackFlow Stock Negative Check (before/150) against a purpose-created product. Posts a production receipt of 100, a dispatch of 30 and a stock adjustment of 5, then asserts the derived stock_bal row holds 75 and equals an independent recomputation of the ledger; finally attempts a dispatch of 1000 against that 75 and asserts the row is NOT inserted, covering the negative side of the guard.
sys_atf_test.name: SnackFlow: stock balance posting, adjustments and negative-stock prevention
